worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.summary: Fire one mystical beam from each eye; the two beams converge from the two eye points and meet on the target. The first lights the target up and the second resonates into that point, hitting harder if the first landed. Resonance form is slower but scales; simultaneous form fires both almost at once, quicker, but with no resonance bonus.
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.use.0: One beam from each eye, converging on one target
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.use.1: Light it up first, then resonate the second beam deeper
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.use.2: Ranged single-target strike with no contact
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.description.1: The beams are %1$s apart. If the first hits, the second gains up to %2$s resonance power.
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.resonance.on: Resonance form now: the first beam fires, then the second resonates into the lit point after a pause and gains a bonus if the first landed; slower, with a longer gap.
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.resonance.off: Simultaneous form now: both beams fire almost together, quicker, each settling independently, but with no resonance bonus.
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.growth.0: From level %1$s the power per beam rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.growth.1: From level %1$s the power per beam is %2$s and the resonance bonus rises to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.growth.2: From level %1$s the power per beam rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.preference.re: On (resonance): the first beam fires, then the second resonates into the lit point after a pause and gains a bonus if the first landed; the cost is a slower cast (+1 tick windup, longer gap). Off (simultaneous): both beams fire almost together at x0.95 each, quicker, but with no resonance bonus.
worldcombat.skill.twinbeam.preference.ai: Beyond this distance it will not fire beams and closes in first; a larger value starts the exchange sooner.
When on, low-health targets rank higher so the two beams finish them; when off, all targets rank the same.
When on, the companion may leave its post to fire beams; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
